_about: Special-event road closures (engine/events.py). The City's feed files an event's closures with its organizer as contractor; 'organizers' names the big ones and says which get the map's banner. Events not listed here still show on the layer, named from their closure text, without a banner unless they have at least 'bannerMin' closures. 'lead' is how many days before an event its banner starts showing. 'corrections' fix an organizer's closures where the feed disagrees with a more trusted notice (see engine/events.py); 'streets' is the centreline file added stretches are traced along.

corrections.note: Times from the Toronto Police closure notice.
corrections.addedNote: Added from the Toronto Police closure notice; the City's feed doesn't list this stretch.
corrections._rules: First match wins. The City's feed files Saturday's 5K closures as one block from Saturday 3 a.m. to Sunday 5 p.m.; the police give Bay Street from 4 a.m. and Lake Shore and lower Bay from 8 a.m. to 1 p.m. The streets police don't list (Front, King, Temperance, Wellington West, Saturday's Richmond, Adelaide and Queen) are dropped. Bay Street north of Front (latitude 43.64598) is the 4 a.m. part.
corrections._add: Stretches the police list that the feed leaves out. Where the police give no reopening time, each takes the end of the feed's closures on the same street or corner.
